Name: Fat Shane 2- Electric Boogaloo
Author: maxhi77
Description:
I loved [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1053]the original fat Shane mod[/url], but I'm not a huge fan of modifying base game XNBs, and I wanted a fat Shane who would change outfits for the beach and seasons- So, I present to you- Fat Shane 2, now without XNBs. Just drop it into your mods folder, and voila!
Much love to the [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/KarmaWG?gameId=1303]original author[/url] of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1053]original mod [/url]and the [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/acescrewsup?gameId=1303]author[/url] of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21382]Fat Shane Beach addition[/url]
